native_findings: FontManager::drawCharacter writes native glyph pixels via Segment::setPixelColorXY and supports flat or two-color vertical gradient fills; it has no alpha parameter or built-in entry/exit lifecycle.
Segment::blendPixelColorXY exists in the pinned WLED source and blends a new color against the segment pixel.
Current HBNF overlay is drawn over a newly rendered base frame each frame; overlay TTL expiry reveals the next base frame.

review_options.concept: Brightness ramp into stable native glyph hold.
review_options.compatibility: Small timing/brightness glue over FontManager; no alternate renderer.

review_options.concept: Vibe-aware two-tone glyph fill using the native vertical gradient; it is a gradient, not a literal outline/contour.
review_options.compatibility: Native gradient is available, but a Vibe-to-renderer mapping is not frozen.

review_options.concept: Blend native glyph pixels into the live Matrix frame during entry/exit.
review_options.compatibility: Requires an alpha parameter/update to the native FontManager drawing path to call Segment::blendPixelColorXY; no custom bitmap/font renderer, but this is a native source adaptation absent from the pinned baseline.

text_treatment_capability_review.acceptance_boundary: No treatment/font aesthetic is selected or frozen. These are feasibility options, not runtime implementation or acceptance evidence.
